combat_abilities.description: Perforin pore formation. Initiates membrane puncture — the first, irreversible commitment. Applies 'pore_open' status to target, enabling granzyme_cascade follow-up.
Granzyme enzyme payload delivered through open pore. Target begins apoptotic cascade — destroys itself from inside. Requires prior cytolytic_strike on same target this combat.
Full granule release — all seven payload stores at once. Devastatingly complete. Applies 'granules_depleted' — Sylvaris cannot use cytolytic_strike or granzyme_cascade until rest phase completes.

MHC-I surveillance protocol. Continuous scan of surface protein signatures. Legitimate targets are pre-marked before engagement. Degrades under target-pool depletion — misidentification probability rises after 72h without confirmed kill.
Cytotoxic granule regeneration from marrow signal. Clears 'granules_depleted' status after one rest phase. Cannot activate mid-engagement sequence.

lore.archetype: Immune Circuit — NK-SAI / T3 Cytolytic Operative
lore.excerpt: She does not deliberate. The decision was already made at the surface protein level. You are not a target because she chose you. You are a target because your MHC-I is compromised. She is simply the chemistry that executes the sentence the biology already wrote.
lore.scent: Dry iron, warm copper, faint medicinal botanical thread. The by-product of precision chemistry. Something says clinical; the temperature says alive.
lore.activation_tell: 0.8 seconds of crimson vein tracery at wrist and temple. By the time you see it, the granules have already reached the engagement site.
lore.hold_protocol: There is no hold protocol. The pore is either open or it is not. There is no intermediate state.

tides.interaction: Indigo confirms before Red commits. The engagement is complete before Red activates, because Indigo ran recognition first.

physical.hair: Crimson-arterial red fading to pale gold at tips, asymmetric crop
physical.eyes: Jade-green luminous, cytokine bioluminescence pulse at activation
